verified_by: human review (proven_live overclaim -> freshness_basis typed basis)
features.description: Schema gaps (operator-triage/v0, additive): resolution[] (derived from bucket+exact_command), asserted_at (from updated_at), proven_live (default false; true only when proven live this build), provenance_source (stable producer id). Agent parity: CLI/agent-brief/dashboard inherit additively.
features.acceptance: Producer emits the 4 fields on every item; resolution is enumerated + bucket-correct; proven_live defaults false (never fakes confidence); existing CLI + dashboard fixtures unbroken; contract note written; Python tests cover derivation + honest defaults.

features.description: Visual system + tokens (spec §2): semantic token set (--bucket-* / --freshness-* / --scope-* / --run-*), Inter + JetBrains roles, light+dark via data-theme, comfort/dense via data-density on :root, no raw hex in components.
features.acceptance: One token file; both themes + both densities render from one DOM; components reference semantic tokens only (no raw hex); existing pages keep rendering.

features.description: The atom re-rendered (spec §3): comfort card + dense row (same fields, spacing only) + 'you're clear' empty state; resolution affordances replace copy-command-as-primary. [deps: F001,F002]
features.acceptance: Card + row render identical fields; resolution buttons map 1:1 to resolution[]; empty queue shows the calm payoff; vitest unit tests.

features.description: Cockpit merge (spec §1.2, J1/J3): fold NEEDS ATTENTION into Cockpit sub-views; dock the terminal; inspect-why right panel (5 fixed sections). [deps: F002,F003]
features.acceptance: Cockpit shows queue + needs-* sub-views from one model; inspect panel renders what/why_now/evidence/provenance/resolution in order; vitest tests.

features.description: Gate + dock (J2, J4, §5.5): approve/request_changes/reject resume flow; side-by-side armed terminal with persistent red hazard frame; terminal OFF by default. [deps: F003,F004]
features.acceptance: Approve removes item + names the run; armed state shows non-dismissible red hazard + scope; disarm one click; vitest tests for the gate logic + armed-state rendering.

features.description: Domain regroup (spec §1): 8 tabs -> Cockpit / Work / System; dissolve Repair into the queue as a resolution; Architecture under Work. [deps: F004]
features.acceptance: Nav is three domains with sub-nav; Repair items appear in the cockpit queue; Architecture lives under Work; drift-guard tests updated.

features.description: Freshness everywhere (spec §2.2, §6): filled/hollow dot grammar (proven vs asserted) + desaturation of stale/unproven across surfaces. [deps: F001]
features.acceptance: Items render filled dot only when proven_live; hollow ○ unverified otherwise; stale desaturated + banner; never full-confidence on unproven; vitest tests.

features.description: Navigable architecture (spec §9): per-level Mermaid (docs/architecture/levels/*.mmd) generated from architecture.json; C4 breadcrumb zoom; per-node drift coloring from source_fingerprint; regenerated on the commit hook. [deps: F007]
features.acceptance: Each level <=~25 nodes; .mmd files deterministic + diff-able; node drift colored from file-hash vs snapshot; replaces the 208KB flat graph; tests for slice generation + drift coloring.
